reason: The README clearly describes a plugin whose primary purpose is interactively previewing generated HTML, local pages, and web URLs through inline panels and a floating window.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中以内嵌面板或浮动窗口预览生成的 HTML、本地页面和网页地址。
summaries.en: Previews generated HTML, local pages, and web URLs in DeepSeek Harness through inline panels or a floating window.

capabilities: opens and displays local HTML files or directories containing index.html
opens and displays HTTP or HTTPS web pages
provides tools to replace, refresh, and close preview sessions
provides draggable, resizable, and fullscreen preview windows
